defs.def: an arrangement that sb has with a bank, etc. to keep money there, take some out, etc. 账户

ex.s: It takes no account of the context.
ex.t: 它没有考虑语境。

ex.s: *Social Security card        *Bank  account
ex.t: *社会保障卡        *银行账户

ex.s: Bank account and Letter of support.
ex.t: 银行账户和支助通知书。

ex.s: brought under discussionD.taken into account
ex.t: 提上议程D. 考虑在内

ex.s: In some cases, local produce might have used more energy and produced more greenhouse gases than produce grown a long way away - even taking into account its transport.
ex.t: 在某些情况下，本地农产品可能比远距离种植的农产品消耗了更多的能源并产生了更多的温室气体——即使考虑到其运输。

ex.s: attend job trainingD. set up a new email account
ex.t: 参加工作培训 D. 建立一个新的邮箱账户

ex.s: In fact, more than one account suggests that while Newton was certainly inspired by a falling apple, there is no proof that it hit him on the head.
ex.t: 事实上，不止一个说法表明，虽然牛顿确实受到一个落下的苹果的启发，但没有证据证明它砸中了他的头。

ex.s: In the end, I turned on my phone to check, but couldn’t resist having a quick look at my social media accounts.
ex.t: 最后，我打开手机查看，却忍不住快速看了一眼我的社交媒体账户。

defs.def: a written record of money that is owed to a business and of money that has been paid by it 账目
an arrangement with a shop/store or business to pay bills for goods or services at a later time, for example in regular amounts every month 赊销账；赊欠账；赊购
an arrangement that sb has with a company that allows them to use the Internet, send and receive messages by email, etc. （互联网、电子邮件等的）账户，账号

ex.s: Once in your account, select Electronic Articles Received.
ex.t: 进入你的账户后，选择“已收到的电子文章”。

ex.s: To obtain the article or chapter, click on the link provided in the email and log into your ILL account.
ex.t: 要获取该文章或章节，请点击邮件中提供的链接并登录你的馆际互借账户。

ex.s: With a Handshake account, students can receive information about career events and personalized job recommendations.
ex.t: 有了Handshake账户，学生可以接收职业活动信息和个性化的工作推荐。

defs.def: a written or spoken description of sth that has happened 描述；叙述；报告
an explanation or a description of an idea, a theory or a process （思想、理论、过程的）解释，说明，叙述

ex.s: The results held true even after the scientists accounted for the participants’ overall health status.
ex.t: 即使在科学家对参与者的总体健康状况作了说明之后，结果还是真实的。

ex.s: It’s a brief account of a trip.
ex.t: 它是一趟旅程的简要记述。

ex.s: To give a brief account of AI history.
ex.t: 简要介绍AI的历史。

defs.def: because you want to and you have decided, not sb else 自愿地
to be the explanation or cause of sth 是 … 的说明（或原因）

ex.s: And not all historical accounts are the same.
ex.t: 而且并非所有的历史记载都是一样的。

ex.s: Another factor that should be taken into account is the effect of human attention on the animals.
ex.t: 另一个应被考虑的因素是人类注意力对动物的影响。

ex.s: 21 What percentage of global transport emissions did road vehicles account for in 2018?
ex.t: 21 2018年道路车辆占全球交通排放的百分比是多少？

defs.def: to give an explanation of sth 解释；说明

ex.s: We invest a lot in roads that help us rush through, but we fail to account for the true costs.
ex.t: 我们投入巨资修建让我们匆匆穿行的道路，却未能说明真正的代价。

ex.s: This dazzling carpet, really a reflector, drove away the rays of the sun with wonderful intensity, which accounted for the vibration which passed through every atom of liquid.
ex.t: 这块耀眼的地毯，其实是一个反射器，以惊人的强度驱散了太阳的光线，这解释了穿过每一粒液体的震动。

defs.def: to be a particular amount or part of sth （数量上、比例上）占

ex.s: Lighting accounts for about 7% of the total electricity consumed in the US.
ex.t: 照明约占美国总用电量的7%。

ex.s: Africa 2,400; and Asia and the Pacific perhaps 3,200, of which Papua New Guinea alone accounts for well over 800.
ex.t: 非洲2400种；亚洲和太平洋或许3200种，其中仅巴布亚新几内亚就占了800多种。

ex.s: Researchers in Spain and England recently found that the worms of the greater wax moth can break down polyethylene, which accounts for 40% of plastics.
ex.t: 西班牙和英格兰的研究者最近发现，大蜡螟的幼虫能分解占塑料40%的聚乙烯。

ex.s: According to the World Bank, China accounts for about 30 percent of total   67   (globe) fertilizer consumption.
ex.t: 根据世界银行，中国约占全球____67____（globe）化肥消费总量的30%。

ex.s: Oaks and sweetgums, which currently account for a majority of the city’s trees, produce huge amounts of a chemical substance called isoprene.
ex.t: 目前占城市树木大多数的橡树和枫香树，会释放大量一种叫做异戊二烯的化学物质。

ex.s: At the start of this year, foreigners living in Italy amounted to 4.56 million of a total population of 60.6 million, or 7.5 percent, with immigrants’ children accounting for an even larger percentage of births in Italy.
ex.t: 今年年初，居住在意大利的外国人达456万，占总人口6060万的7.5%，而移民子女在意大利出生人口中所占比例甚至更高。

ex.s: As the world races to decarbonize everything, it faces particular problems with transportation — which accounts for about a quarter of our energy-related greenhouse gas emissions.
ex.t: 随着全球竞相为一切去碳化，交通面临着特殊难题——它约占我们与能源相关的温室气体排放的四分之一。

defs.def: to know where sb/sth is or what has happened to them, especially after an accident （尤指在事故之后）了解，查明
to defeat or destroy sb/sth 打败；破坏；摧毁；消灭
